theorems.name: Submission.ts_blowup_cutoff_closedBall_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < t → ((∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, f y ≤ 1) → (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, 1 < ‖y‖ → f y ≤ 0) → ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂μ ≤ μ.real (closedBall x t)) ∧ ((∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, 0 ≤ f y) → (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ f y) → μ.real (closedBall x t) ≤ ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂μ)
